name: Tryum - Bao don hang ve Telegram

nodes.name: Tryum events
nodes.notes: Production URL is /webhook/tryum-events. Respond is 'When Last Node Finishes' on purpose: responding immediately would return 200 before Telegram is called, so a failed send would be recorded as DELIVERED and never retried. Raw Body must stay on - the signature covers the exact bytes, and a parsed-then-reserialized body rewrites decimals (200000.00 -> 200000).

nodes.name: Verify and format
nodes.notes: Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto and TRYUM_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the n8n container.
